nodes.rationale: [05 - Conversations/home-belajarcarabelajar-proyek-snipset/2026-09-27 - c9-regression-test-net-gap [ses_f1ace56bfffenwLmmdrdTnlMZ1].md:L2980] `play_audio_feedback` short-circuits at `audio.rs:65-67` on the `AUDIO_ENABLED` guard, so `play_raw_ogg` is never reached. **But even if the guard were open, it would still prove nothing about sound:** `SND_SNIPPET` is a `OnceLock` that is only ever populated by `init_audio_from_preferences`, which **no test ever calls**. So `SND_SNIPPET.get()` returns `None`, and `if let Some(d) = data` at line 81 skips the call entirely.

nodes.rationale: [05 - Conversations/home-belajarcarabelajar/2026-09-29 - c2-kwin-effect-control [ses_f1074ac85ffeKjeuONaXYT7adF].md:L3061] **2. The restore path was broken on first write, and I only found it because I tested it.** The EXIT trap referenced `$CONTROL_EFFECT` while `generate_mode` assigned a local `control_effect`. Under `set -u` the trap died on an unbound variable instead of unloading, so the injected-SIGINT run **left `blur` actually loaded on your desktop**.
